detail: Completed his secondary studies at the private Catholic institution Saint-Adjutor in Vernon and obtained a baccalauréat in economics and social sciences.

qualification: Law degree (licence); master's (M1/maîtrise) in public law begun but not completed
detail: Obtained a law degree (licence) and began a master's in public law that he did not complete. His official biography for years described him as holding a master's degree; in September 2025 he acknowledged the master's was never validated and his CV was corrected to refer to 'law studies at Panthéon-Assas'.
